description: This file contains controller functions for executing differential analysis, managing manifests, running Python scripts, processing CSV data, and persisting diff and commit entities within a version control analysis tool.

methods.name: ExecuteDifferentials
methods.description: Executes differential analysis targets based on application configuration, managing manifest creation, script execution, and output transfer.

methods.name: defineCommonManifest
methods.description: Initializes a common upstream manifest by executing 'repo init' and reading the generated manifest XML.

methods.name: createWorkingPath
methods.description: Creates a directory path with appropriate permissions.

methods.name: printFunctionDuration
methods.description: Logs the duration taken by a function execution.

methods.name: clearOutputDirectory
methods.description: Removes all contents of the specified output directory.

methods.name: setupCommand
methods.description: Prepares an exec.Cmd to run a Python script with specified manifest URLs and branches.

methods.name: runPyScript
methods.description: Runs the differential Python script, detects output CSV files, and returns their filenames.

methods.name: diffTarget
methods.description: Executes the differential Python script with timing and error handling.

methods.name: TransferScriptOutputToDownstream
methods.description: Reads CSV files, applies mutations, and persists diff and commit entities.

methods.name: loadTargetManifests
methods.description: Loads upstream and downstream manifest XML files into manifest entities.

methods.name: readCSVFiles
methods.description: Reads and converts CSV files into diff and commit row entities.

methods.name: persistEntities
methods.description: Persists diff and commit rows into repositories after mapping the diff target.

methods.name: csvFileToDiffRows
methods.description: Converts CSV file lines into DiffRow entities.

methods.name: toDiffRows
methods.description: Casts generic entities to DiffRow entities.

methods.name: CSVFileToCommitRows
methods.description: Converts CSV file lines into CommitRow entities.

methods.name: toCommitRows
methods.description: Casts generic entities to CommitRow entities.

methods.name: persistDiffRowsDownstream
methods.description: Inserts diff rows into the project repository.
